fasta: the three sequences the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on (the scaffolds DF978536.1 and DF980041.1 and the mitochondrion NC_007788.1) at their full length from Acanthaster_planci_gca001949145v1.OKI_Apl_1.0.dna.toplevel.fa.gz of Ensembl Genomes release 63 (Ensembl Metazoa), the file held to the sum of the directory's CHECKSUMS; every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 441 records on the scaffold DF978536.1 (256 records), the scaffold DF980041.1 (2) and the mitochondrion NC_007788.1 (183); 22 of them name their sequence by a synonym the cache's chr_synonyms.txt lists (DF978536, NW_019091402, NW_019091402.1 and oki_scaffold48 for the first scaffold, MT and NC_007788 for the mitochondrion). 373 come from tools/vep-seeded-variants (generator version 3, seed 1, --records wide --per-category 40, one --sequence for each of the three sequences, every reference allele read from the genome file), their IDs naming the category and an ordinal: 29 categories, among them a substitution in a codon genetic code table 9 reads unlike the standard code, start and stop codons under tables 1 and 9, a missense and a synonymous change on each strand, both splice sites, both untranslated regions, an intron, upstream, downstream and intergenic positions, a frameshift insertion, a frameshift deletion, an in-frame deletion, the first and the last base of each sequence and a deletion across the origin of the mitochondrion, which the cache states circular. 68 are designed records on the mitochondrion's thirteen coding transcripts, each reference base read from the genome file and held to the cached coding sequence: in every transcript a substitution that makes a codon table 9 translates unlike table 1 (code9_makes_codon, the four such codons taken in turn from transcript to transcript), one that makes such a codon and keeps the residue (code9_keeps_residue), one that makes one and alters the residue (code9_alters_residue) and one on a codon of the coding sequence that is such a codon (code9_on_codon); in the seven transcripts whose closing stop codon is one substitution from such a codon, that substitution (code9_at_stop); in the transcript whose first codon the published table 9 marks as a start and the reference image's table does not, a substitution at the codon's first base and one at its third (code9_start_mark); the same two in each of the two other transcripts whose first residue the cache sets by a sequence edit (code9_edited_start); and in the three transcripts whose coding sequence ends inside a codon, a substitution at its last base (code9_incomplete_end). Two exemplars per consequence-set combination the two references show, stratified by variant class and strand, six per combination carrying a protein-level term, plus the records the manifest's included_records name: every generator record at a sequence's first and last base, across the origin, on the organelle, on the first and the last sequence and of the table 9 categories, the first nine of every other generator category, and the 68 designed records. The cache names no known variant, so no record carries a variation identifier; no record is multi-allelic
